items.title: Long constructor = over-busy class
items.rule: A constructor taking more than 7 collaborators is a finding: split the class (Extract Class) or bundle travelling values (Introduce Parameter Object).
items.source: `MF-art/injection.html` §Constructor versus Setter Injection; `MF/DataClump`; ours: `ChatOrchestrator.java:133` 32 params; `Tool.java:60` 29; 57 ctors ≥7 in AP main
items.extra: Legend: MF = martinfowler.com/bliki · RC = refactoring.com/catalog · RK = rameezk/skills@937d90d martin-fowler-code-smells.md · SF = spring-framework@69a298b8e · SB = spring-boot@f6142c9f4 · SJF = spring-javaformat@525867fe8 · AP = agent-platform origin/master@772736bf (`…/` = src/main/java/ai/aruvii/). Full notes: research/58-fowler-spring-codebase.md.

items.title: No flag arguments
items.rule: A boolean parameter that selects which operation runs is a finding: split into two named methods, or take a sealed/enum input.
items.source: `MF/FlagArgument` §Tangled Implementation, §Deriving the flag; ours: `RagIngestionService.java:72,94` `forceReembed`; DS3 covers flows, not signatures

items.title: Extract by intent, not length
items.rule: Extract a fragment you must read to understand into a method named for what it does; a comment explaining *what* is the cue.
items.source: `MF/FunctionLength` ¶1-3; ours: No method-level rule; `ChatOrchestrator.java` 1405 lines

items.title: Logic over one record lives on the record
items.rule: When callers read two or more fields of one record to compute or check something, move that logic onto the record as a method.
items.source: `MF/GetterEradicator` (Beck's rule); `MF/TellDontAsk`; `MF/AnemicDomainModel`; ours: not measured; tension with S-3 (X5)

items.title: Hide Delegate vs Remove Middle Man are inverses — SHARPEN
items.rule: Hide Delegate and Remove Middle Man are inverses: fix a chain or a pass-through by whichever removes coupling at real call sites; never add a wrapper then flag it.
items.source: `RC/removeMiddleMan` ("inverse of Hide Delegate"), `RC/hideDelegate`; ours: `RK:19-20` list both, no note; AP: 0 three-getter chains in main

items.title: Complete the Fowler baseline — SHARPEN
items.rule: Add Long Function, Long Parameter List and Data Class to the review smell baseline; note it is a 12-smell subset of Refactoring 2e ch. 3.
items.source: §2.1; ours: SEAM1 + ADR17:221-225 cite `RK` as "the Fowler smells baseline"

name: 2 · design.md — seam shape from Fowler (SEAM1 / S-1..S-7 sharpenings)

items.title: Query vs modifier (CQS) — SHARPEN
items.rule: A method that returns a value changes no observable state; a modifier returning its own outcome (CAS `Won`/`Lost`) or a fluent `this` is the stated exception.
items.source: `MF/CommandQuerySeparation`; `RC/separateQueryFromModifier`; `MF/FluentInterface`; ours: NM3 covers names only

items.title: Role interfaces, not header interfaces
items.rule: An interface declares only the methods its consumer calls; a port whose consumers each use a different subset is split into role interfaces.
items.source: `MF/RoleInterface`; `MF/HeaderInterface`; ours: 5 ports with 8-9 methods, e.g. `aruvii-shared/…/shared/llm/InteractionPort.java`; consumer use not checked

items.title: Expand–migrate–contract for published contracts
items.rule: Change a published contract (stream payload, DB column, public API) by expand → migrate → contract across releases; in-repo-only APIs keep DS5 (one change).
items.source: `MF/ParallelChange`; ours: DS5 forbids dual paths everywhere; no rule for wire/DB contracts

items.title: Default* impl is final + package-private — SHARPEN
items.rule: A seam's Spring implementation is `final` and package-private; callers get it as the interface; no `Impl` suffix.
items.source: SF `DefaultRestClient.java:86`, `DefaultRestClientBuilder.java:64`, `RestClient.java:84`; ours: `DefaultAgentEvalPublisher.java:16` not final; `LlmAdapterRegistryImpl.java:15` public `Impl`

name: 3 · Spring's own codebase — gates and conventions (SP13+, SP1-12 are testing)

items.title: Wire complexity + nesting gates
items.rule: Wire the S-6/DS9 gates: Checkstyle `CyclomaticComplexity` max 5 and `NestedIfDepth` set so DS9 (three levels) fails the build.
items.source: SF checkstyle.xml:70-78; SJF :57-65; ADR17:218; ours: AP `checkstyle.xml` has neither
items.recommend: ADOPT (S-6 claims a gate that does not exist)

items.title: No @PostConstruct in main
items.rule: No `@PostConstruct` in main code; startup checks go in the constructor, start-up work in `ApplicationRunner`/`SmartLifecycle` (SC19, SC20).
items.source: SB checkstyle.xml:27-35; ours: 5 live uses (`ChatResponseSubscriber.java:44`, `RagIngestSubscriber.java:55`, `GlobalTrustStore.java:56`, `JdbcSslAdapter.java:36`, `KafkaTriggerManager.java:59`)

items.title: No System.out/err/printStackTrace in main
items.rule: No `System.out`, `System.err` or `printStackTrace()` in main code, except a `main` method; gated by Checkstyle regex.
items.source: SF checkstyle.xml:226-237; ours: `HashEmbeddingAdapter.java:35`

items.title: Utility class final + private ctor
items.rule: A static-only class is `final` with a private constructor; gate `HideUtilityClassConstructor` + `FinalClass`.
items.source: SF CONTRIBUTING.md:572-587; SF checkstyle.xml:47-49; ours: `AdapterHttpHelper.java:26,30` already compliant

items.title: Public method in package-private class only if override
items.rule: In a package-private class, a method is `public` only when it overrides; gate it with SJF `SpringMethodVisibilityCheck` or ArchUnit.
items.source: SJF `SpringMethodVisibilityCheck.java:53-67`; ours: AP scan: 0 violations

items.title: Precondition message names the parameter — SHARPEN
items.rule: A precondition message names the parameter first: `requireNonNull(sessionId, "sessionId must not be null")`.
items.source: SF CONTRIBUTING.md:470-492; ours: 4 `requireNonNull` without message; `RedisModelOverrideStoreAdapter.java:47` bare name

items.title: @NullMarked packages + NullAway
items.rule: Every main package has `package-info.java` with `@NullMarked`; a nullable type says `@Nullable` (JSpecify); NullAway checks it.
items.source: SF CONTRIBUTING.md:494-560; FW null-safety §Defaults to non-null, §Configuration; ours: 0 `package-info.java` / 1020 main files; 2 files import `org.jspecify`
items.recommend: HOLD — fold into the OQ-R27-6 spike (D3)

items.title: *Customizer beans for a shared builder
items.rule: When several modules must adjust one shared builder, each contributes a `@FunctionalInterface *Customizer` bean; the owner applies them via `orderedStream()`.
items.source: SB `RestClientCustomizer.java`, `RestClientAutoConfiguration.java:85`, `RestClientBuilderConfigurer.java:63-73`; ours: 0 own customizers; no current need

items.title: Immutable builders for config objects
items.rule: (proposed) Config-style objects use an immutable builder whose setters return a new instance.
items.source: SB `ThreadPoolTaskExecutorBuilder.java:110-111`; ours: TY13 bans builders

items.title: File reads as one author
items.rule: (proposed) Place a new member beside related ones; a file reads as written by one author, not as change history.
items.source: SF CONTRIBUTING.md:450-462; ours: —

items.title: Contradiction: ST1 / JV5: `final var` for locals
items.rule: ST1 / JV5: `final var` for locals
items.source: SF CONTRIBUTING.md:596: "`var` … is not permitted" in main code
items.recommend: **Keep ours.** Spring is a library read on GitHub without an IDE; ours is an app; JV5 already limits `var` to types visible on the right. Record the divergence

items.title: Contradiction: TY13: no builder classes
items.rule: TY13: no builder classes
items.source: Spring builds config objects with builders (SF `RestClient.java:231`, `RetryPolicy.java:123,148`; SB `ThreadPoolTaskExecutorBuilder.java`)
items.recommend: **Keep TY13** for our values; add one line: *using* a library's builder is fine, we don't write our own

items.title: Contradiction: S-1 (each seam an interface + `Default*`) vs LY2 (interface only for a
items.rule: S-1 (each seam an interface + `Default*`) vs LY2 (interface only for a faked boundary or module boundary)
items.source: `MF/InterfaceImplementationPair`: dislikes one-impl interfaces in applications; Spring's pairs are published library APIs
items.recommend: **Reconcile in S-1 text:** pure decision seams (`RecoveryPolicy`) are `final` classes with no interface; I/O seams get the interface (they are faked). 57 of 67 AP `*Port` interfaces have exactly one main impl — allowed by LY2 as module boundaries

items.title: Contradiction: DS5: migrate every caller and delete the old path in one change
items.rule: DS5: migrate every caller and delete the old path in one change
items.source: `MF/ParallelChange`: expand/migrate/contract "still useful" even with control of all usages
items.recommend: **Scope DS5** to in-repo APIs; FW4 for published/persisted contracts

items.title: Contradiction: S-3 decide-or-do (decisions in pure policy classes over records)
items.rule: S-3 decide-or-do (decisions in pure policy classes over records)
items.source: `MF/AnemicDomainModel`: behaviour-less domain objects are an anti-pattern; but `MF/GetterEradicator`: "Layering often trumps this"
items.recommend: **Tension, not conflict.** Keep S-3 for cross-object decisions; FW6 keeps single-record logic on the record

items.title: Contradiction: SC18: `@PostConstruct` allowed for checks / in-memory setup
items.rule: SC18: `@PostConstruct` allowed for checks / in-memory setup
items.source: SB bans the import in its own main code (checkstyle.xml:27-35); no reason given in the file

items.title: Decision: FW1 threshold
items.rule: a) 5 · b) 7 · c) no number, review judgement
items.source: research/58 §7
items.recommend: **b) 7** — no first-party number exists; 7 flags the 57 worst AP constructors and leaves ordinary services alone

items.title: Decision: `@PostConstruct` (X6)

items.source: research/58 §7
